items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: I have an excellent saxophonist that doubles on the flute named Sports Lewis

ctx.x: How many do you have in your group?

I have four members, including myself; but I have three musicians and a vocalist. I'm playing the Hammond organ and two (unintelligible) speakers. Of course, that is a B-2 would be two, and I have an excellent saxophonist that doubles on the flute named Sports Lewis, and he's actually an easterner. He's from around Philadelphia (unintelligible), Pennsylvania, and he's been playing for quite a few years. Plays an excellent flute, plays a very good swing tenor tune, and he's a good reader, and he's learned my style…
Uh-huh. How old a man is he?
